bottleneck.description: Near-monopoly licensor and supplier of phosphorescent red/green OLED emitter materials and IP, with a patent estate of 7,000+ issued/pending worldwide that gates panel-maker bills of materials.

dependency.key_customers: Samsung Display, LG Display, BOE Technology, CSOT, Visionox, Tianma, JOLED legacy IP licensees
dependency.key_suppliers: PPG Industries (exclusive emitter material manufacturing partner), specialty organic-chemistry CDMOs

editorial.notes: UDC is the de facto sole commercial supplier of phosphorescent (PHOLED) red and green emitters used across virtually all modern AMOLED displays for smartphones, TVs, and IT panels; competing emitters from Japan/Korea remain hemmed in by cross-licensing. Long-term supply/license agreements with LG Display (extended through 2030), Samsung Display, BOE, and CSOT cement the position, supporting ~42% operating margins. The reason this sits at HIGH (not CRITICAL) is that core patents begin to sunset late-decade and blue PHOLED commercialization is still in qualification — but through the 2026 horizon the chokepoint is real and structural.
